description_en: Queries the data detection results of data tables and files
description_zh: 调用本接口查询数据表、文件的数据识别结果
name: DescribeDataObjects

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Default value: zh_cn. Valid values:
zh_cn: Chinese.
en_us: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh_cn。取值：
zh_cn：中文。
en_us：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of data asset instances to return per page in a paged query. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置列表中每页显示的数据资产实例的最大条数。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number in a paged query. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时的页码。默认值：1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
We recommend that you specify this parameter. The list of product IDs to query, separated by commas. Valid values:
1: MaxCompute
2: OSS
3: ADB-MYSQL
4: TableStore
5: RDS
6: SELF_DB
7: PolarDB-X
8: PolarDB
9: ADB-PG
10: OceanBase
11: MongoDB
25: Redis

OSS is mutually exclusive with other products. If OSS is included in the query, no other products can be specified. By default, non-OSS products are queried
parameters.help_zh:
建议填写，待查询的产品ID列表，多个用逗号分隔。取值：
1：MaxCompute
2：OSS
3：ADB-MYSQL
4：TableStore
5：RDS
6：SELF_DB
7：PolarDB-X
8：PolarDB
9：ADB-PG
10：OceanBase
11：MongoDB
25：Redis

OSS与其他产品互斥，即如果待查询中有OSS，则不能有其他产品列表；默认查询的为非OSS产品
parameters.name: product_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of parent category IDs of the templates to query, separated by commas
parameters.help_zh: 待查询模板的父分类列表，多个父分类ID用逗号分隔
parameters.name: parent_category_ids

parameters.help_en: The keyword of the data object to query
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的数据对象关键字
parameters.name: query_name

parameters.help_en:
The region where the asset resides. Valid values:
cn-beijing: China (Beijing).
cn-zhangjiakou: China (Zhangjiakou).
cn-huhehaote: China (Hohhot).
cn-hangzhou: China (Hangzhou).
cn-shanghai: China (Shanghai).
cn-shenzhen: China (Shenzhen).
cn-hongkong: Hong Kong (China)
parameters.help_zh:
资产所在的地域。取值：
cn-beijing：华北2（北京）。
cn-zhangjiakou：华北3（张家口）。
cn-huhehaote：华北5（呼和浩特）。
cn-hangzhou：华东1（杭州）。
cn-shanghai：华东2（上海）。
cn-shenzhen：华南1（深圳）。
cn-hongkong：中国香港
parameters.name: service_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The industry template ID.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2399296.html to obtain the industry template ID
parameters.help_zh:
行业模版ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2399296.html获取行业模板标识ID
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The data domain ID to which the data asset belongs
parameters.help_zh: 数据资产所属的数据域ID
parameters.name: domain_id

parameters.help_en:
The data tags to query, separated by commas. Valid values:
101: personal sensitive information.
102: personal information.
107: general information
parameters.help_zh:
待查询的数据标签，多个用逗号分隔。取值：
101：个人敏感信息。
102：个人信息。
107：通用信息
parameters.name: model_tag_ids

parameters.help_en:
The risk levels of the data assets to query. Separate multiple values with commas (,).
2: S1, low risk level.
3: S2, medium risk level.
4: S3, high risk level.
5: S4, highest risk level
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的数据资产的风险等级，存在多个时使用英文逗号（,）隔开。
2：S1，弱风险等级。
3：S2，中等风险等级。
4：S3，高风险等级。
5：S4，最高风险等级
parameters.name: risk_levels

parameters.help_en: The keyword of the asset instance ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The model IDs of the industry template, separated by commas.
You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2536491.html to obtain the industry template model IDs
parameters.help_zh:
行业模板的模型ID，多个ID通过逗号分隔。
您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2536491.html获取行业模板模型标识ID
parameters.name: model_ids

parameters.help_en:
The OSS file type supported for detection.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2536492.html to obtain the supported OSS file types. Use the Code field value from the response. This parameter is valid only for OSS asset queries
parameters.help_zh:
支持识别的OSS文件类型。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2536492.html获取支持识别的OSS文件类型，取返回值中的Code字段值，本参数仅对OSS类型的资产查询有效
parameters.name: file_type

parameters.help_en: The file category code
parameters.name: file_category_code

parameters.help_en: The member accounts ID
parameters.name: member_account

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] This parameter is deprecated
parameters.name: feature_type

parameters.help_en: The identifier used for canary release evaluation
parameters.help_zh: 使用这个来进行灰度判断
parameters.name: api_version

parameters.help_en: The region of the data catalog display page
parameters.help_zh: 数据目录展示页的区域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The product of the data catalog
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en: The rule filter
parameters.name: rule_ids

parameters.help_en: The risk level filter
parameters.name: risk_level_id_list

parameters.help_en: The task name filter
parameters.name: table_name

parameters.help_en: The database name filter
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en: The task ID filter
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The OSS bucket filter
parameters.name: bucket

parameters.help_en: The SLS project filter
parameters.name: project

parameters.help_en: The SLS Logstore filter
parameters.name: log_store

parameters.help_en: The data catalog SLS page has two layers. This parameter indicates whether the query is at the Logstore dimension
parameters.help_zh: 数据目录的sls页面有两层，需要用这个进行判断，是查找的logstore维度数据
parameters.name: log_store_flag

parameters.help_en: The file path filter
parameters.name: path

parameters.help_en: The EngineType
parameters.name: engine_type

parameters.help_en: The facet dimension for associated filtering in the data catalog. Valid values: rule (category), task (task), instance (instance), and db (database). If this parameter is not specified or is empty, the original list and count query is performed (behavior unchanged). If a valid value is specified, the list query is skipped and only content.hitValues is returned. If an invalid value is specified, a parameter error is returned
parameters.help_zh: 数据目录关联过滤的分面维度，取值白名单：rule（分类）/ task（任务）/ instance（实例）/ db（库）。不传或为空走原列表+count 查询（行为不变）；传合法值时跳过列表查询，只返回 content.hitValues；传非法值报参数错
parameters.name: facet_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to filter revision items
parameters.name: is_revision

parameters.help_en: The Cursor
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.help_en: The CursorDirection
parameters.name: cursor_direction
